name: RocketRide 3.6 AI Pipeline Engine
description: Self-hosted RocketRide engine for AI pipelines, webhooks and MCP, key-gated

PORT.description: Engine port: WebSocket API, /mcp, webhook and chat endpoints (public domain and healthcheck).

ROCKETRIDE_APIKEY.description: API key every client sends (SDK, CLI, VS Code, MCP Bearer, webhooks). Generated; rr_ + 16-200 chars or the engine stays locked.

RR_PARAM_TOKEN_SECRET.description: Key that encrypts the secure parameters saved in pipelines. Generated; keep it, or saved secrets must be entered again.

ROCKETRIDE_QDRANT_HOST.description: Qdrant on the private network, for pipelines (the ROCKETRIDE_QDRANT_HOST reference, port 6333).

ROCKETRIDE_COLLECTION_NAME.description: Default Qdrant collection for pipelines (the ROCKETRIDE_COLLECTION_NAME reference).

ROCKETRIDE_LOG_LEVEL.description: Engine log level (debug, info, warning, error).

PORT.description: Qdrant REST port (healthcheck); private network only.

QDRANT__SERVICE__HOST.description: Listen on IPv4 and IPv6 (Railway private network).

QDRANT__TELEMETRY_DISABLED.description: Do not send anonymous usage statistics to Qdrant.
